description: Change the address receiving the owner's yield share. Pending cooldown payouts use the treasury in effect when claimed. Review the destination before confirming. Requires fresh JWT and auth_verify_otp in this process. Signs the merchant smart account on the vault's network through the SCX paymaster and bundler, billed to prepaid balance on mainnet. Before signing it ensures sponsorship exactly as the dashboard does: it may create a 'Merchant dashboard' paymaster client and allowlist the vault for the merchant's sponsored clients — both persist even if the transaction then fails. Sponsorship failure blocks the action. Indexer results can lag confirmed receipts; never blindly retry an uncertain transaction.

confirm.description: Explicit acknowledgement of this owner action.

expectedVault.description: Vault address from the deployment you reviewed; a changed target blocks the write.

mode.description: Network mode; required unless exactly one key mode is cached.

name: yield_vault_treasury_set
title: Set the vault owner treasury
